answer: Quorum grading makes a fake identity expensive to defend: every answer must be attested by several established, non-kin peers before it earns anything, so a sybil swarm cannot attest itself into rewards. An opal of real reputation forms only through independent reviewers, a falcon-eyed panel spots copied or templated texts quickly, and a karst of hollow accounts collapses because it has no genuine peers willing to stake their own standing on its work.
